text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
O-Oh! Amazing!
To think you caught this many for me!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I was truly fated to meet
both this one and that one!
Thank you, Trainer!
choice_data_list: All that matters is that they're happy.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's throw a welcome party
for these girls right away!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
From today on, they're the companions who'll live alongside me.
Don't you think we should give them a grand celebration?! Right?!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ah, if you have any requests,
I'll take whatever you've got!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
It's also a thank-you to the Trainer
who worked so hard to welcome these kids!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Looks like this is gonna be a fun party!
